title: Stereoselective cardiotoxic effects of metconazole on zebrafish (Danio rerio) based on AGE-RAGE signalling pathway.
authors: Li, Minmin; Yang, Lin; Wang, Rui; Li, Lin; Zhang, Yifan; Li, Long; Jin, Nuo; Huang, Yatao; Kong, Zhiqiang; Francis, Frederic; Fan, Bei; Wang, Fengzhong
journal: The Science of the total environment
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲霜灵对斑马鱼的对映选择性心脏毒性，涉及分子对接但核心是毒理学与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Metconazole (MEZ) is a novel chiral triazole fungicide that is widely used to prevent and control soil-borne fungal pathogens and other fungal diseases. However, it has a long half-life in aquatic environments and thus poses potential environmental risks. This study evaluates the acute and stereoselective cardiotoxicity of MEZ in zebrafish (Danio rerio) embryos. In addition, transcriptomics, real-time quantitative PCR, enzyme activity determination, and molecular docking are performed to evaluate the molecular mechanisms underlying the cardiotoxicity of MEZ in zebrafish. MEZ decreases the heart rate while increasing the pericardial oedema rate; additionally, it induces stereoselective cardiotoxicity. 1S,5S-MEZ exhibits stronger cardiotoxicity than 1R,5R-MEZ. Furthermore, MEZ increases the expression of Ahr-associated genes and the transcription factors il6st, il1b, and AP-1. Heart development-related genes, including fbn2b, rbm24b, and tbx20 are differentially expressed. MEZ administration alters the activities of catalase, peroxidase, and glutathione-S-transferase in zebrafish larvae. Molecular docking indicates that 1R,5R-MEZ binds more strongly to the inhibitor-binding sites of p38 in the AGE-RAGE signalling pathway than to other MEZ enantiomers. Studies conducted in vivo and in silico have established the enantioselective cardiotoxicity of MEZ and its underlying mechanisms, highlighting the need to evaluate the environmental risk of chiral MEZ in aquatic organisms at the enantiomeric level.
abstract_zh: Metconazole (MEZ) 是一种新型手性三唑类杀菌剂，广泛用于防治土传真菌病原体及其他真菌病害。然而，其在水生环境中半衰期较长，因此存在潜在的环境风险。本研究评估了MEZ对斑马鱼（Danio rerio）胚胎的急性及立体选择性心脏毒性。此外，采用转录组学、实时定量PCR、酶活性测定及分子对接技术，以评估MEZ对斑马鱼心脏毒性作用的分子机制。MEZ降低心率，同时增加心包水肿率；此外，其诱导立体选择性心脏毒性。1S,5S-MEZ表现出比1R,5R-MEZ更强的心脏毒性。进一步地，MEZ增加了Ahr相关基因及转录因子il6st、il1b和AP-1的表达。心脏发育相关基因，包括fbn2b、rbm24b和tbx20，出现差异表达。MEZ处理改变了斑马鱼幼鱼中过氧化氢酶、过氧化物酶和谷胱甘肽-S-转移酶的活性。分子对接表明，1R,5R-MEZ与AGE-RAGE信号通路中p38抑制剂结合位点的结合强度高于其他MEZ对映体。体内及计算机模拟研究确立了MEZ的对映选择性心脏毒性及其潜在机制，强调在手性对映体水平上评估MEZ对水生生物环境风险的必要性。
